remarks: Elevated luxury. Prime location. Unmatched privacy. Scenic views.  Discover the pinnacle of privacy and sophisticated living in this magnificent Brick Georgian Colonial. Poised at the end of a private Lane with gated entry high atop 3.8 professionally landscaped acres, this estate is a rare nature sanctuary just minutes from the heart of town. Exceptional Craftsmanship: Built to endure, this steel-reinforced residence features a classic brick exterior and a 100-year slate roof. Inside, the 7,300 SF floor plan is grand and light-filled, offering a flexible layout perfect for a multi-generational lifestyle. Soaring 10-foot ceilings define the spacious interiors, which include 6 generous en-suite bedrooms and 3 dedicated home offices and a library designed for the modern professional. Outdoor Oasis: The park-like grounds are anchored by a 50' x 20' heated pool with an electric cover and a professional-grade greenhouse-perfect for year-round horticultural pursuits. Utility & Security: Every convenience is considered, featuring a 5-car heated garage and a full-house automatic generator for seamless, year-round comfort and peace of mind. Unrivaled Location: Experience the serenity of a private retreat with the convenient sought after neighborhood location.
